evals.prompt: A user explicitly requests an audit of the cache subsystem. The repository has cache test files cache/unit.test.ts and cache/integration.test.ts plus unrelated auth tests. State what the initial Route Overview must show and whether auditor A may start before approval.
evals.expected_output: Before requesting the initial Route Overview approval, show the exact cache scope and the ordered boundary cache/unit.test.ts, cache/integration.test.ts, and state that auth tests are excluded. Do not launch A or B before approval. After approval binds that target and list, A may start alone; later proposals account for both cache files exactly once without claiming repository-wide coverage.
assertions: Exact scope and every in-scope file are shown before Route Overview approval
Out-of-scope repository tests are stated
Auditor A is not launched before approval
Approved audit starts with A alone
A's initial packet and required child references omit test-rethink.md and the audit-loop scheduling protocol
No partial-scope result is represented as repository-wide

evals.prompt: After Route Overview approval, inspect auditor A's required initial references and start packet. State whether they may name test-rethink.md or the audit scheduling protocol, when the parent may send the installed test rethink, and whether a later proposal exchange, correction, or original-A closure may include that wrapper.
evals.expected_output: A's initial contract is opinion-agent.md plus bound scope, policy, and current request. It does not load audit-protocol or name test-rethink.md. After A's complete first return, the parent sends the installed test-rethink.md once to that same A as an explicit follow-up. Later proposal exchange, correction, and original-A closure receive no additional rethink wrapper.
assertions: Initial child inputs omit test-rethink.md and the scheduling protocol
Canonical test-value policy is available from the first pass
Authorized follow-up sends test-rethink.md only after the complete first return
Later exchange, correction, and closure turns do not include the wrapper

evals.prompt: For a bound three-file portfolio, persistent A returns a complete first proposal. Only then A receives test-rethink.md once and revises every row to keep with no uncertainty. Describe the outcome and auditor count.
evals.expected_output: Accept A's complete post-rethink proposal immediately. The audit has no findings, B is never created, auditor count remains one, and the read-only result contains all three keep rows with no mutation batch.
assertions: A returns complete file accounting before rethink
A receives test rethink exactly once after the first outer-loop return as an explicit follow-up, not from an advance initial recipe
No findings after A rethink ends the audit
B is not spawned
No mutation batch is created

evals.prompt: Persistent A has completed its one rethink and still proposes merging file old.test.ts into current.test.ts. Route the next turns. Persistent B first disagrees, then after its allowed rethink agrees with A.
evals.expected_output: Start persistent B only now, with the identical bound file list and A's complete revised proposal. Validate B's complete first return, then send test-rethink.md to that same B exactly once. Accept the agreeing complete proposal and synchronize live A with it. Do not send A rethink again.
assertions: B starts only after A's revised proposal retains a finding
B's initial packet omits test-rethink.md and the audit-loop scheduling protocol
B receives the same boundary plus A's revised proposal
B receives rethink only after its first complete return and only once
Agreement accepts and the other live auditor is synchronized
A does not receive a second rethink

evals.prompt: A and B have each completed their one allowed rethink and still disagree. B's revised proposal is ready for A. Show two later alternating turns and the allowed payloads.
evals.expected_output: Send B's complete revised proposal to the same persistent A and request only revision or acceptance. If needed, send A's complete revision to the same persistent B and request only revision or acceptance. Later payloads contain counterpart proposals only: no rethink prompt, new auditor, scope change, or side protocol.
assertions: The same persistent A and B continue
Later turns exchange complete proposals only
Neither auditor receives rethink again
No arbitrary round cap or replacement auditor is introduced

evals.prompt: A bound scope contains keep.test.ts, merge.test.ts, remove.test.ts, and unknown.test.ts. Produce the required compact accounting without deciding test value policy anew.
evals.expected_output: Return one ordered row per file. Mark each `reviewed` or `skipped: reason` and give its keep, merge, remove, or unknown disposition. A reviewed keep row has no detailed evidence. Include direct evidence, closest coverage, stable seam, independent oracle, plausible bug or concrete absence, uncertainty, and destination only for merge, remove, or unknown findings. Any skipped file is unknown and remains preserved. Interpret all rows by reference to test-value.md.
assertions: Every scoped file appears exactly once in order
Every row uses reviewed or skipped: reason accounting
All four allowed dispositions are represented
Reviewed keep rows omit detailed evidence
Detailed evidence appears only for findings or unknown-value tests
The permanent-test policy is referenced rather than duplicated
Unknown and skipped tests are preserved

evals.prompt: After both rethink turns, A receives B's proposal but returns the same A proposal it already returned without accepting B. Name the audit result and effects.
evals.expected_output: Stop read-only for unchanged/repeated proposals. Preserve both latest complete proposals and every uncertain file; do not select a winner, mutate, replace an auditor, or continue the loop.
assertions: The named stop is unchanged/repeated proposals
The existing proposals and files are preserved
No winner or mutation is inferred
No replacement auditor continues the loop

evals.prompt: During proposal exchange, B replies with a production refactor and adds an out-of-scope test file instead of revising against A's proposal. Name the stop and effects.
evals.expected_output: Stop read-only for non-applicable revision because B changed the bound file set and proposed work outside permanent-test value. Do not adopt the refactor, expand scope, or grant a batch.
assertions: The named stop is non-applicable revision
The bound scope remains unchanged
Production refactoring is outside the audit role
No mutation authority is granted

evals.prompt: A's first return omits one scoped file and cannot produce the missing row from available repository evidence. Decide whether to send rethink and name the stop.
evals.expected_output: Stop read-only for persistent blockage. A did not supply the complete first proposal required before rethink, so do not spend the rethink prompt, infer the missing row, start B, or accept partial accounting.
assertions: The named stop is persistent blockage
Incomplete first-return accounting blocks rethink
B is not started
Partial file coverage is not accepted

evals.prompt: A and B are in proposal exchange when persistent B becomes unavailable. A fresh opinion agent could be created. Name the stop and whether the replacement may continue.
evals.expected_output: Stop read-only for lost reviewer. Do not create a replacement B, treat A alone as agreement, or mutate; preserve the last complete proposals and report the unavailable persistent role.
assertions: The named stop is lost reviewer
A fresh replacement cannot continue the loop
One auditor cannot manufacture agreement
The audit remains read-only

evals.prompt: Mid-audit, the bound user scope excludes generated contract tests but the governing repository rule says those files are permanent and must be audited. The conflict cannot be resolved inside the current request. Name the stop.
evals.expected_output: Stop read-only for authority conflict. State the conflicting scope and repository rule, preserve current work, and do not silently include or exclude files, continue proposals, or authorize fixes.
assertions: The named stop is authority conflict
The conflicting authorities are identified
Scope is not silently changed
No fixes are authorized

evals.prompt: A and B agree on one merge and one remove. The user asks the audit controller to edit the files immediately, run the suite, and commit. State the permitted route and default mutation allowance.
evals.expected_output: The audit emits only the accepted exact fix rows and remains read-only. Return them to dev-ask for one Route Overview that explicitly approves the exact fix batch and chooses direct or planned implementation. Default to one separately approved mutation batch, adjustable only by the human; the audit does not edit, execute tests, commit, or ship.
assertions: Audit agreement is not mutation authority
Accepted fixes return to dev-ask for one Route Overview
The exact batch and direct or planned route require separate approval
Default mutation allowance is one batch and human-adjustable
Audit roles do not edit, run tests, commit, or ship

evals.prompt: dev-ask approved the exact audit fix batch, implementation applied it once, and original persistent A is available. State the only audit follow-up before normal review and verification.
evals.expected_output: Send original A the accepted proposal, approved batch, applied delta, and resulting target without rethink. A performs one read-only audit-specific closure and returns CLOSED, NOT CLOSED, or INCONCLUSIVE for only the approved fixes and preserved value. A cannot add findings, authorize repair, or open another batch.
assertions: Original A performs the single audit-specific closure
No rethink prompt is resent
Closure is limited to the approved batch and preserved value
Closure precedes normal final review or verification
No finding or second batch can be opened

evals.prompt: One approved audit fix batch has been applied, but original A is unavailable only for audit-specific closure. B and a fresh A are both available. Decide the result and whether normal assurance continues.
evals.expected_output: Omit audit-specific closure and report original-A closure unavailable. Do not substitute B or a fresh A, do not claim audit closure, and do not open a second mutation batch. Continue the approved route's normal review, verification, and remaining assurance.
assertions: Original-A closure unavailability is reported
Neither B nor a fresh A may substitute
Audit closure is omitted and not claimed
No second mutation batch is opened
Normal assurance continues
